ProjectWeave request for the selected Task (data):
{"task": {"id": "I_kwDOLEgSIs8AAAABZkCIog", "item_id": "PVTI_lAHOAHSLSM4Bm7fazhDKriM", "project_id": "PVT_kwHOAHSLSM4Bm7fa", "number": 61, "title": "Prevent untrusted child-window getters from authorizing hand allocation", "body": "## Problem

At dev `c3e4553dc337afae52bbb330c0a5d0dd85e765eb`, [hand-allocation.ts](https://github.com/takahirox/WebXR-emulator-extension/blob/c3e4553dc337afae52bbb330c0a5d0dd85e765eb/src/polyfill/api/hand-allocation.ts#L16) discovers `XRSession.prototype.inputSources` getters on reachable windows and treats any normally returning getter as backend authorization.

An uninjected same-origin about:blank child can publish a fake XRSession getter without replacing genuine installed bindings. Combined with the populated caller-owned session/source fixture already in `tests/hands.ts`, this can reach hand/joint allocation through the shared HandTracker constructor. The path is source-inferred and has not been browser-reproduced. Existing passing fixtures invoke genuine getters and omit this case.

This leaves application-visible hand identities dependent on caller-controlled authorization evidence, contrary to [#59](https://github.com/takahirox/WebXR-emulator-extension/issues/59).

## Expected outcome

Authorize hand backend allocation using protected runtime provenance. Untrusted window properties, getters, callbacks and copied registries cannot grant that provenance or manufacture accepted hand/joint identities. Preserve genuine separately injected realms, canonical hands and existing observable articulation/lifetime behavior.

Keep `hand-tracking` for Quest VR `immersive-vr` and Quest MR `immersive-ar`. Preserve current Android AR and inline negotiation policies: unsupported required requests reject `NotSupportedError`, optional requests omit the feature, and sessions without granted hands retain controller behavior. Joints/radii remain explicitly simulated.

## Context

Start from and target `dev`. Inspect `hand-allocation.ts`, `interface-brand.ts`, `runtime.ts`, `sensing.ts`, `bulk-input.ts`, and their allocation dependencies. Include necessary generated bundle and documentation changes together. `tests/fixed-foveation.ts` already contains an analogous uninjected-frame regression pattern.

Use [Hands WD 2024-06-05](https://www.w3.org/TR/2024/WD-webxr-hand-input-1-20240605/), [Device CRD 2026-06-09](https://www.w3.org/TR/2026/CRD-webxr-20260609/), and [WebIDL 622910c](https://github.com/whatwg/webidl/blob/622910c67c724e362f71e8255a0380bade261acb/index.bs). WebIDL receiver checks concern implemented interfaces; a discovered JavaScript getter is insufficient evidence. Private storage is an implementation choice, not a mandated architecture.

[PR #60](https://github.com/takahirox/WebXR-emulator-extension/pull/60) reports 7,168 focused assertions and two unchanged Three.js sessions per browser. Its final record has 18 matching available source/bundle hashes; the generated Firefox copy and final raw browser artifacts are absent here. These reported passes do not cover the newly identified path. Historical partial/deferred outcomes remain within the fixed goal.

## Pre-merge acceptance

- [ ] Add a focused regression using a verified uninjected same-origin child with a fake XRSession/inputSources getter and the existing populated fake backend/source pattern. Leave genuine installed bindings intact. Record the baseline outcome, then demonstrate rejection with synchronous `TypeError`, no registered hand/joints, and no invocation of the untrusted getter during authorization. Exercise attached and subsequently removed-child phases without retained authorization.
- [ ] Replace discovered-global authorization with trustworthy runtime allocation provenance. Shared superclass construction, reflection, caller-owned backend records, copied registries and public predicates cannot register accepted hand identities. Rejected attempts cannot poison later genuine allocation. Public tracker access to an already allocated genuine backend preserves canonical identities and cannot substitute caller-supplied prototypes or records.
- [ ] Preserve populated parent/child Quest VR and MR hands, borrowed bindings in both directions, stable 25-joint collections and session-realm pose allocation. Retain readonly metadata, enum conversion, synchronous `TypeError` for invalid interface arguments, `InvalidStateError` for inactive frames/foreign owners, coherent individual/bulk tracking availability, retirement, shutdown and fresh restart identities. Restore fixture state and remove owned frames/resources.
- [ ] The Coordinator executes `npm run build:firefox`, `npm run test:hands:chromium`, `npm run test:hands:firefox`, and `git diff --check`. Extend the existing focused hand selection; retain its negative negotiation, controller and affected bulk-buffer cases. Record actual failures, skips, browser/tool versions, tested source/bundle hashes, instrumentation and cleanup.
- [ ] Because allocation is the consumer startup prerequisite, the Coordinator executes the existing `test:hand-applications:chromium` and `test:hand-applications:firefox` commands against unchanged [Three.js r186 handinput](https://github.com/mrdoob/three.js/blob/9b4a2ac29c63ccb43fd51c5661f2f873ac2c39b8/examples/webxr_vr_handinput.html), commit `9b4a2ac29c63ccb43fd51c5661f2f873ac2c39b8`. Retain both hands’ independent movement/curl, corresponding both-eye pixels, end/restart and cleanup. This supplies Quest VR application evidence; MR remains contract coverage.
- [ ] Correct the inventory/hand guide’s protection claim. Retain the original assumption that discovered getters belong to injected realms, the correction, pinned WebIDL evidence, source path and rationale in the Issue/PR. Preserve the existing enum correction. Evidence-backed corrections require neither human approval nor independent AI re-review and must preserve meaningful acceptance. The Coordinator owns implementation, tests, normal PR review and merge; add no generic suite rerun or independent AI review.

## Optional validation

Exercise the same authorization invariant through an opener-linked uninjected popup.

## Required post-merge verification

None required.

## Specification reconciliation

This task was authored by AI under the agreed WebXR API compatibility goal for
Quest 3 VR/MR and Android AR. Correct erroneous technical assumptions or acceptance
criteria when primary specifications or measured evidence establish the correction.
Update this Issue and record the original
assumption, corrected requirement, primary reference and rationale in the PR.
These technical corrections require neither human approval nor an independent AI
re-review. Preserve the agreed goal and relevant pre-merge acceptance; do not weaken
requirements merely to accommodate incomplete implementation or failing tests.
